review_kind: IMPLEMENTER_SELF_REVIEW (regret, same-policy realization, short-horizon corollary); not an independent reviewer attestation

scope.mechanisms: One of S,G remains fixed for the whole run. Competitors use allowed receipt/action histories, independent private randomness, shared wallet and horizon. Neither mechanism nor full Store/label is exposed.

quantifiers.general: Any nonempty finite fixed mechanism family; any nonempty shared policy class; any nonnegative real weights summing to one. Weighted oracle minus a proved common Bayes upper bound lower-bounds infimum worst regret; any actual common achiever supplies the upper. Equality is asserted when the two match.
quantifiers.consumer: All legal real full-history causal kernels, arbitrary controller memory, and all seven affordable alternatives on the registered joint model. every_raw_has_shared_realization preserves both per-mechanism J values simultaneously. The bound is not inferred from the two returned paths or table candidates.

dual.interpretation: Dual witness only. It neither supplies the mechanism to the policy nor sets an empirical prior.

deterministic.lattice: For each frozen deterministic table and world, 4*2^H*sourceValue is an integer. The two equally likely modes per tick affect value; primitive label is value-blind. Stage payoff is quarter-integral, including actual fees. At H=3 both per-model values, oracle differences, and their maximum lie in (1/32)Z.
deterministic.conclusion: The strictly positive all-policy 3/128 lower bound rounds up to 1/32 only for deterministic tables; returnedG has worst regret 1/32. deterministic_minimax_exact takes the infimum over supported-feasible deterministic tables.

actual.same_definition: RegisterMechanismDecisionConsumer.returned : Fin 4 → Table Act Obs 3; one independent uniform draw, seed 0 chooses returnedS and seeds 1/2/3 choose returnedG. The input to this selector is only the seed.
actual.comparison: minimax_regret_exact plus returned_beats_every_raw_regret and native consumer bridge; source expected J also equals complete Store expected payoff.

proof_trust.meaning: The last item on each line is a generated native_decide evaluation axiom. These two closed calculations and corollaries that use them rely on compiler/native evaluation. The printed name is not Lean.ofReduceBool. Independent exact Fraction and complete execution checks corroborate the results; neither removes this trust dependency. Plain decide and the stopped high-memory kernel-expansion attempt did not establish these equalities.

boundaries: Short-horizon common policy attains 13/16 at the registered H2 input. No same-H3 learning benefit is inferred from a terminal test, no asymptotic result is claimed, and empirical applicability remains UNVERIFIED. Publication and GI are separately owned by the coordinator.
